suppress.notes: False positive. The liquibase-mongodb extension jar is matched to the CPE of the MongoDB server (cpe:/a:mongodb:mongodb) because its name contains "mongodb" and its version 5.0.3 matches a MongoDB server version. The reported CVEs (CVE-2024-1351, CVE-2025-14847, ...) are MongoDB server vulnerabilities; the jar contains no server code. The MongoDB Java driver it uses is scanned separately as mongodb-driver-*.

CVE-2026-41115 concerns the ACL check that the Kafka broker applies to the CONSUMER_GROUP_DESCRIBE API (DESCRIBE instead of the documented READ on the GROUP resource). It is enforced by the broker, not by kafka-clients, and Apache has stated that the implementation is correct and only the documentation changes, so no fixed release exists (affected range 4.0.0 to 4.3.0). Mitigation is on the broker side: review consumer group ACLs for least privilege.
